<<chapter=II>>
<<chapter_ornament>>
<<top_bar>>
Five days of rain – The drowned man’s map – A
disagreement about north – The heron again.
<<bottom_bar>>

It rained for five days. The marsh rose and took back
the stations one by one, and Tomás counted them off from
the window like a man reading names. On the sixth
morning the water stood level with the chandler’s step
and a pair of otters were seen in the high street, going
about their business.

Osric Penn sent for her at noon. He had found, at the
bottom of the biscuit tin, a map made by the drowned
man: a single sheet, much folded, showing the marsh as
it had been twenty years before. Every channel on it ran
the wrong way. Ada turned it round twice and then
